assessment: All 13 retained main-PDF pages were text-read and inspected as full renders; four figure pages were enlarged. Four numbered figures with fourteen lettered panels, three schematic subplots within Fig 3a, all captions/legends, Methods and all 93 printed bibliography entries were inspected. Forty-one limited checks, four ring comparisons, six temperature rows, two synthetic mask orders, 400 synthetic extrapolation rows and six conditional pure-fluid states do not reproduce the native GIS/IAM/climate models. sections.scope: Introduction: CCS/CDR, climate budgets and risk
sections.assessment: Read all net-zero/negative definitions, historical capture/resource estimates, EOR, alternative sinks and uncertain future demand. Preserve historical dates, stock/flow and abatement/removal boundaries; direct original support remains incomplete.

A normative harm-prevention resource assessment with sequential geospatial exclusion masks. The planetary limit is conditional on these choices, not a field maximum, legal quota or confidence-calibrated probability.
Read geology/seal/fault/state screening, storage 1000–2500 m and ocean≤300 m central bounds. Main historic seismic wording differs from the probabilistic hazard metric specified in Methods.

Protected/polar regions and future built-up urban buffer 25 km. Methods specifies SSP5 urban 2100, not the largest-population SSP. Health mechanisms are cited qualitative risks, not calibrated failure or exposure models.

Read European policy examples, EEZs, international-law opinions, London Protocol and contested boundaries. Historical policy snapshots and study assumptions are not verified current legal permissions.

sections.scope: A holistic risk assessment and Figure 2 caption
sections.assessment: Read initial 11800 Gt→1460 Gt(1290–2710), country heterogeneity, applied-order loss attribution and every Fig 2 panel/legend. Ring totals need native region/case reconciliation; no guessed relabelling.

Read all capture/CDR pathways, five persistent storage uses, net-zero/end-century scenario comparisons, relative-year versus calendar-year exceedance and temperature potential. Sensitivity ranges are not posterior probabilities.

Read fairness, historic responsibility, GDP, CDR finance, mineralization, implementation/injectivity and climate-response limitations, and final policy recommendations. Recommendations are not optimized or operationally demonstrated policies.

All 93 printed entries read with native line/page/column provenance. R024 exact Wei 2021 original selected passages checked. Other 92 direct originals remain unverified; malformed/incomplete author metadata retained literally.

sections.scope: Methods: Geospatial analysis and volumetric conversion
sections.assessment: Read global sediment polygons, GADM v 4.1,1° depth, closed-system pressure rationale and .037 Gt/1000 km³ for 50 years. Pressure is considered through a borrowed effective coefficient; no native basin-specific pressure/rate history is modeled here.

sections.scope: Methods: protected, EEZ, polar and seismic layers
sections.assessment: Read WDPA May 2024, EEZ clipping/joint regimes, ±66.5° and GEM/USGS hazard thresholds. All masks require versioned native inputs/CRS/resampling to reproduce.

sections.scope: Methods: population, ocean depth, storage depth and disputes
sections.assessment: Read SSP5/2100 buffers 25/5 km, >121000 mixed-status wells, ocean 300 m(100–500), mean sediment depths 1.9/2.5 km, central formation 1000–2500 m and contested/war-like areas. Native thermodynamic surface basis and density prose remain unresolved.

sections.scope: Methods: transboundary assumptions and sensitivity calculations
sections.assessment: Central terrestrial 6 nautical-mile buffer each side, sensitivity 0/12 nm; plume may reach farther. Each layer applied sequentially, layer sensitivity replaces that layer after previous central layers; native combined-case construction requires code/SI.

sections.scope: Methods: scenario analysis and regional allocation
sections.assessment: AR6 Emissions|CO2 and Carbon Sequestration|CCS, pyam annual interpolation, cumulative sums through 2100, first sign-crossing net-zero year, remaining-stock/rate years, scipy slinear extrapolation through 2300 and R5 region analysis. Exact-zero, noncrossing, negative-rate and endpoint conventions require native code.

sections.scope: Data/code availability, acknowledgements, contributions and disclosures
sections.assessment: Read exact GitHub/Zenodo/explorer URLs, ArcGIS Pro workflow, funding, author roles, no declared competing interests, SI and advertised peer-review reports. Public availability statements do not establish local retrieval, version correspondence, license for all inputs or independent reproduction.
